# heytea.dev

heytea.dev is a singleton status dashboard and public API for the HeyTea Downtown Metreon location at 165 4th St, San Francisco.

## Public API

Base URL: https://api.heytea.dev

- GET /status: current store state, wait time, queue counts, notices, and freshness.
- GET /wait-time: current wait-time fields only.
- GET /notice: current store notice.
- GET /closing-notice: current closing notice, if any.
- GET /history?range=24h&bucket=5m: bucketed historical wait-time data.
- GET /stream: server-sent events for live updates.
- GET /openapi.json: OpenAPI schema.

There are no store IDs, no location endpoints, no menu endpoints, and no /v1 prefix. The service is only for the configured Downtown Metreon location.

## Docs

- Human/API docs: https://docs.heytea.dev
- MCP server: https://mcp.heytea.dev
- Status page: https://status.heytea.dev
